## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new capability
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `style` — formatting, no behavior change
- [ ] `refactor` — restructuring, no behavior change
- [ ] `perf` — performance improvement
- [ ] `test` — tests only
- [ ] `build` / `ci` / `chore` — tooling, dependencies, releases
- [ ] `revert` — reverts a previous commit
- [ ] **Breaking change** — requires a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer on the commit
